title: Canonical Political Identity Resolution & Disambiguation Matrix
governance: Master Execution Framework Rule IV-001 (Zero False Merges Invariant)

identifiers.description: Unique candidate identifier issued by Election Commission of India on Affidavit Portal
Official Lok Sabha / Rajya Sabha Secretariat member biographical ID
State Election Commission / Chief Electoral Officer Form 21E Declaration Notification
Verified foreign key linkage already sealed in public.canonical_persons

compoundKeys.name: COMPOUND_BIOGRAPHICAL_KEY
compoundKeys.rationale: Two individuals with identical legal names, exact identical dates of birth, identical parent names, in the same state is statistically zero.

compoundKeys.name: COMPOUND_POLITICAL_CAREER_KEY
compoundKeys.rationale: Incumbent winning 2018 and contesting 2023 in the same constituency under the same or continuous party platform.

rules: Names match but dates of birth differ by 1-3 years (potential age misreporting in affidavit vs true DOB)
Names match and constituency matches but party differs without an explicit recorded defection/switch event
Common patronymics or title variations (e.g., "Rao", "Reddy", "Sharma", "Singh", "Kumar") with partial career overlap
Must remain separate canonical candidates in public.candidacies without merging human identities until human verification

conflictTriggers.description: A person cannot simultaneously be an active sitting MLA in Telangana and an active sitting MLA in Bihar on the same date D.
Date of birth discrepancies > 5 years or parent name contradiction.
Different human beings with identical or similar names contesting the same seat in the same election cycle (common dummy candidate tactic in Indian elections).
Source records explicitly identify the candidates as distinct individuals.

governanceRule: NO AUTOMATED MERGE MAY OVERRIDE AN EXPLICIT IDENTITY CONFLICT MERELY BECAUSE A NUMERICAL SIMILARITY SCORE IS HIGH.
